description: Recurring and agentic task registry for MasterIndex entities.

notes: Use entry ids from current/index.json as task target keys.
Tasks are intentionally stored outside the core inventory file.

globalTasks.name: MasterIndex refresh
globalTasks.purpose: Refresh the shared inventory baseline and preserve schema stability.

globalTasks.name: Collaborator activity watch
globalTasks.purpose: Keep a unified snapshot of collaborator (Jim / Carol / Steve) repo activity so Bill can see, from the dashboard, where each stands and what awaits his action — without opening a session per collaborator.
procedure: For each entry in current/index.json `collaborators[]`, for each repo in `.repos`:
gh pr list --repo {repo} --state open   -> openPRs; count those NOT authored by billdonner as collaboratorOpenPRs
Set awaitingYourAction = true when the newest open PR (or newest issue/comment) on the repo is authored by someone other than billdonner.
Write results back into collaborators[].lastActivity and set checkedAt to the run date. GitHub only (no email scan).
notes: Declared per Bill's request 2026-08-04; runs on the same executor as masterindex-refresh (option b).
Steve maps to pfolio as end-user; the repo's code collaborator is @rachelelise — reconcile if Steve should have his own GitHub identity tracked.
